items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: Like a long time like Johnny Brown and Wooden Joe and them guys just straight out, you know.

ctx.x: Do you notice any difference between these Dixieland bands nowadays and the ones when you were young, when you were...

Well, yeah, the ones now, they try to play too modernistic, you know what I mean? They try to get modern with it. Like a long time like Johnny Brown and Wooden Joe and them guys just straight out, you know.
In other words, they play a little slower, you mean?
